summary: Verified sticky header + sticky bottom-tab-bar fix inside .ios-frame across all 6 protected /app routes at desktop viewport 1920x900. Header stays pinned to frame top (headerTop=0, frameTop=0). Tab bar stays pinned to frame bottom (tabBottom≈900, frameBottom=900). Frame scrollTop reaches scrollHeight-clientHeight (atBottom=true) on every page, and the last non-spacer child of [data-testid=app-main-scroll] ends at ~829px which is above the tab bar top ~845px — NO content clipping. Drawer opens with all 11 nav links and drawer-logout visible. Demo user plan pill correctly shows ELITE. No blocking console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout sticky implementation is clean and correct: header uses sticky top-0 inside the .ios-frame scroll ancestor, main uses flex-1 native-scroll with a small aria-hidden spacer, and nav uses sticky bottom-0. This is the right pattern for both desktop iOS-shell and mobile window scrolling.
Pre-existing (not related to this fix): duplicate Plaid link-initialize.js script embed warning appears in console on some /app subpages — non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
test_credentials: POST /api/demo/seed returns token + user; demo@milli.app / milli-demo-2026 also works. Stored token as localStorage.milli_token before /app navigation.
seed_data_creation: Demo user seeded via /api/demo/seed for each run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sticky-inside-ios-frame layout is verified working. When testing UI inside .ios-frame on desktop, remember: (1) mobile-menu-btn button is at approximately x=757-795, y=3-41 inside the 1920 viewport (frame is centered ~625px from left). Playwright page.click with force=True on this element can sometimes miss during initial hydration — the reliable pattern is `await page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('[data-testid=mobile-menu-btn]').click())`. (2) To test scroll-to-bottom, target `.ios-frame` not window: `frame.scrollTop = frame.scrollHeight`. (3) `atBottom` check: `Math.abs(frame.scrollHeight - frame.clientHeight - frame.scrollTop) < 2`.

console_warnings: Plaid link-initialize.js embedded more than once (pre-existing, non-blocking)

rca of the issue: Previous iteration's use of position:fixed broke inside the .ios-frame desktop shell because fixed positions to the viewport, escaping the 430x932 frame. The current fix switches to position:sticky with top-0 / bottom-0 on header and nav. Since .ios-frame is overflow-y:auto (thus a scroll container), it acts as the sticky positioning ancestor: header sticks to frame top and nav to frame bottom while main content flows in between. Verified: on every /app route, scrolling the frame to max scrollTop keeps last content visible above the tab bar (829px content bottom < 845px tab top) — no clipping.
